title: Bootstrap deterministic multi-agent foundation
description: Bootstrap the first deterministic multi-agent foundation after Spec v3.1 freeze: Project Map Builder, Workflow/State Controller, invariant tests, governance evidence, and canonical verification integration.

acceptance_criteria.description: Project Map Builder deterministically generates .eqcofe/project-map.json from repository state.
Workflow Controller enforces frozen state transitions and terminal immutability invariants.
Multi-agent foundation gate is included in canonical pnpm verify without removing existing verification gates.
No forbidden sensitive-domain, migration, OpenAPI, or Step 57 product-design files are changed.

bootstrap.reason: Scope/Lock Controller, deterministic Verification Policy, and Protection Drift Monitor do not exist at the start of the first implementation task.

service_dependency.note: The services are not direct code dependencies. They are intentionally delivered in one bootstrap task because a fresh Project Map is a prerequisite to future dispatch, while Workflow/State control is the next required deterministic enforcement layer before normal task orchestration can start.

manual_lock.rule: No overlapping bootstrap implementation may modify this write scope until PR #164 is merged or aborted.

verification_policy.lint: NOT_CONFIGURED_IN_CANONICAL_PACKAGE; not invented as a bootstrap requirement
verification_policy.replacement_end: Deterministic Verification Policy becomes authoritative after its implementation task is merged.

protection_drift_monitor.planned_stage: Frozen implementation order item 6 — Merge Policy / protection validation
protection_drift_monitor.pre_merge_until_then: Manual GitHub protection/status evidence plus CI status must be checked; NOT_VERIFIED never equals PASS.
